title: Physics-guided learning of switching coefficients for near-time-optimal relay control of a DC positioning drive: code and data
description: Simulation code, oracle labels, trained models, evaluation results, tables and figures that reproduce the article “Physics-guided learning of switching coefficients for near-time-optimal relay control of a direct-current positioning drive” (Informatics. Culture. Technology, 2026). The archive contains a model of a DC positioning drive with a relay cascade synthesised by the N-i switching method, simulation-based optimisation of the switching coefficients, a physics-guided scheduler (square-root scaling law plus a residual multilayer-perceptron ensemble), baselines, an ablation study and the evaluation on 2500 test moves. See README.md for instructions.
